manifest.notes: Meta-Lane PR5 (Hans-Go 2026-10-25 PR1-PR6, PR7 NOT included). Synergy packages for RogShai (Ishai + Rograkh) from the 2026-10-25 drafts. Packages were held back from the PR2 refresh snapshot until PR5 wired them as a scoring input; this file adds them without touching the immutable refresh snapshot. All packages are SUGGESTIONS (strength UNKNOWN, popularity is not strength); package compositions are own syntheses (Tier C) from Tier-A EDHREC presence, except where a package description says otherwise. No package is a ban or avoidance list. The cEDH package (engine-spam) is band-separated and never counts for casual bands.

packages.description: Tier A presence (EDHREC), Tier C composition (own synthesis). Band-neutral cantrips feeding the draw/magecraft engine; every cantrip slot costs an interaction or protection slot (no datum proves more cantrips is better).
packages.name: Cantrip chains + draw engine

packages.description: Tier A presence, Tier C composition. The existing heart of the target deck (core only; EDHREC expansion suggestions Birgi, Ledger Shredder, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Monastery Mentor, Young Pyromancer are NOT part of this package).
packages.name: Prowess / magecraft triggers

packages.description: Synergy, NOT a Spellbook combo (no Spellbook page for Jeska+Kediss was retrieved). The target deck's existing finish plus its protection. Thematic additions Temur Battle Rage, Unleash Fury, Mana Geyser are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: Jeska / Kediss finisher

packages.description: Core only (band-neutral cards already in the target deck). The cEDH expansion (Mox Amber, Paradise Mantle, Infernal Plunge, Lotus Petal) is EXCLUDED: it would be a band shift toward fast-mana/turbo, not a ramp gap.
packages.name: Rograkh free mana

packages.description: cEDH RogShai identity, explicitly NOT recommended for the casual target deck (kept as a negative delineation). Band-separated: never counts for high_power or other casual bands.
packages.name: Engine spam / Rhystic Study cluster

packages.description: Thin basis (EDHREC Polymorph variant n=5). Rebuild idea, not an addition: without a deck rebuild Polymorph is random, not a targeted tutor, given the deck's many creatures.
packages.name: Polymorph

packages.description: Tier C composition (target deck + Tier-C primer + n=3 Voltron page). Core only; additions Mother of Runes, Selfless Spirit, Giver of Runes, Lightning Greaves are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: Ishai protection / Voltron light

sources.notes: Card presence from EDHREC lists (see drafts/rogshai/packages_proposal_2026-10-25.md, retrieved 2026-10-25). Package compositions are own syntheses (Tier C), not EDHREC quotations.
sources.title: EDHREC RogShai package sources (2026-10-25)
